decision: No detector-side adaptive controller formulation passed the predeclared robustness gate (CV-mean delta-HOTA > 0 AND >=3/4 of 4 calibration folds individually positive AND non-degenerate action mapping), across 5 independent search stages (Stage 1: 27 exhaustive resolution-mapping configs; Stage 2: 27 exhaustive NMS-mapping configs; Stage 3A: 31 exhaustive cue-subset configs; Stage 3B+4 joint: 60 Optuna-TPE configs over thresholds+action mapping together; plus two oracle/headroom diagnostics and a segment-level diagnostic). Full provenance in DEVELOPMENT_DECISION_REPORT.md and PHASE2_DIAGNOSIS.md.

frozen_policy.type: fixed (static) operating point -- AC-MOT is a documented no-op on this host
frozen_policy.confidence_floor_provenance: CONFIDENCE_EXACTNESS_CHECK.json's original 'not exact' finding was a bug in the verification script (class-filter mismatch), corrected in CONFIDENCE_EXACTNESS_CHECK_FIXED.json (18/18 exact) -- see CONFIDENCE_CORRECTION_NOTE.md. Once confirmed exact, a confidence-floor sweep (CONFIDENCE_ORACLE_RESULT.json) found conf=0.40 robustly beats conf=0.01 at this (resolution,NMS) point: +0.88 pooled HOTA, 7/8 sequences improve, 3/4 CV folds positive -- the first broadly-distributed (non-single-sequence) finding in the whole search. A diagnosis-motivated adaptive follow-up (level-dependent confidence, LOW->0.10/MEDIUM,HIGH->0.40) was tested and found WORSE than flat 0.40 on every one of the 8 sequences -- hypothesis refuted, no adaptive confidence policy beats the flat choice.
frozen_policy.selection_rule: matched-static: the pooled-HOTA-maximizing point among resolution x NMS x confidence-floor on all 8 calibration sequences, ByteTrack host, official evaluator. The adaptive-vs-this-point comparison (Stages 1/2/3A/3B4) predates the confidence-floor correction and used the weaker conf=0.01 reference throughout; all 5 of those stages were null regardless, and the subsequent confidence-floor and level-dependent-confidence checks (run after the correction) are also null -- the conclusion (no detector-side adaptive policy robustly beats the best fixed point) is unchanged by the correction, only the identity of the best fixed point improved.

scene_layer.status: NOT ACTIVATED in the frozen policy (the frozen policy is a constant operating point; SceneLayer's causal level decision has no effect since the action mapping does not vary by level)
scene_layer.note: SceneLayer itself was never modified -- cue formulas kept exactly as historically defined throughout all search stages; only its SceneSpec threshold DATA was searched (Stage 3B+4), and no retuning survived the robustness gate.

thresholds_explored_but_not_activated: searched continuously in [0.10,0.50] (t_med) x [t_med+0.05, 0.90] (t_high) via Optuna TPE, 60 trials; best found did not survive the robustness gate
calibration_split_identity: research/acmot_paper_v2/DETECTOR_SPLIT.json -> calibration (8 sequences, listed in sim.py:CALIBRATION, 3282 frames total)
objective: CV-mean(pooled-HOTA(candidate on fold) - pooled-HOTA(matched-static on fold)), ByteTrack host, tools/v6/eval_official.py
what_is_not_frozen: the old/historical AC-MOT (FrozenSCIController, v1.0.0-acmot-frozen) is untouched and uncompared -- scoped out, see DEVELOPMENT_DECISION_REPORT.md Phase 6.
post_freeze_rule: this policy will NOT be modified based on final held-out VisDrone-val results. Systems 3 and 4 in the final test use this frozen (null/static) policy as-is.
